dict.string: Car Greetings - plays a fasten-seat-belt chime, then speaks an AI-written flight-attendant boarding announcement. Generated by build_car_greetings.py; do not edit on the phone.
Gather the context the announcement is built from: the car and driver, the weather, the time, and the city.
Build the prompt and ask the model. The chime is decoded here but played later, after the model has answered.

You are a cheeky flight attendant. Create a flight boarding announcement for ￼ ￼. make it cool and make it short not more than 40 words, no emojis. Start with "Good afternoon ladies and gentlemen", swapping afternoon for morning, afternoon, or evening based on the current time.
Current Time is: ￼ and weather is: ￼, visibility ￼ and current city is: ￼, ￼. captain is ￼, add some quirky remarks also recommendations based on weather and time of the day, mentioning the current city name and full (not abbreviated) state name. Don't make up any time or location information you haven't been provided. make short end with “seatbelt sign is on, ready for take off”.

Play the chime, then speak. Play Sound deliberately comes AFTER the model call: the answer is already in hand, so there is no dead air between the chime and the speech, and a model failure means silence rather than a chime that promises an announcement which never arrives.
